# Code of Conduct

## Our Pledge

Contributors and maintainers of the AI Solutions Wiki commit to making participation a respectful, harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of background or experience level.

## Our Standards

Behavior that contributes to a positive environment:

- Using clear, accurate, technically grounded language
- Accepting constructive feedback on technical claims
- Crediting sources and original authors
- Being direct about disagreements without being hostile

Unacceptable behavior:

- Harassment or personal attacks
- Deliberately submitting false or misleading technical information
- Dismissing contributions without explanation

## Scope

This code of conduct applies to contributions made via GitHub - pull requests, issues, and discussions.

## Enforcement

Instances of unacceptable behavior may be reported by opening a GitHub issue or contacting the maintainer directly at [lindamohamed.com](https://www.lindamohamed.com). Reports will be reviewed and responded to within 7 days.

Maintainer: **Linda Mohamed** - [linkedin.com/in/lindamohamed](https://linkedin.com/in/lindamohamed)
